title: ProdigeUI Quality Gate Report
description: Schema for Quality Gate reports. Ensures design output meets enterprise-grade standards and is free of AI slop.

overall.description: Overall result: pass only if ALL criteria pass, fail if one or more criteria fail.

criterionResult.description: Result of evaluating a single Quality Gate criterion.

id.description: Unique criterion ID (kebab-case, e.g., no-raw-values, contrast-ratio).

status.description: Criterion status: pass (met), fail (violated), not-evaluable (rule not measurable).

issue.description: Description of the issue found (present when status is fail).

location.description: Location of the artifact where the issue was found (relative path).

recommendation.description: Actionable recommendation for fixing the issue.
